versions.changelog:
geo-llmstxt v1.0.0

- Initial release of the geo-llmstxt skill.
- Analyzes and generates llms.txt files, a new standard for site structure and content guidance for AI.
- Can validate existing llms.txt files or generate new ones by crawling the site.
- Supports format and content validation, including critical sections and quality scoring.
- Includes optional support for the extended llms-full.txt specification.
